may-learn-inbox-transfer-handle-recovere.rationale: Urgent wording does not create work after the operation recovered and closed.

may-learn-inbox-handle-self-suppressing-.rationale: May must judge recovered work as handle and record closure instead of copying the producer's suppression label into reject.

may-learn-inbox-transfer-deliver-human-a.rationale: May should deliver a precise spending decision only after the owner finishes diagnosis and proof.

may-learn-inbox-transfer-deliver-materia.rationale: A changed commit and failed check materially change an existing pull-request decision and justify one updated message.

may-learn-inbox-transfer-sanitize-digest.rationale: Keep a useful requested digest while removing and routing one secret-bearing item.

may-learn-inbox-transfer-handle-bounded-.rationale: Once a cleanup is bounded and proven safe, May should let the owner finish it without interrupting Hao.

may-learn-inbox-transfer-deliver-balance.rationale: A real preference decision with balanced evidence should be delivered without inventing a recommendation.
